next_lane.reason: The direct-Q6 mechanism validates producer-side packed-record ownership. The Q4 source-F16 producer is now the largest format-specific transform at 16.725 ms / 3.18% across 264 launches and uses the same scalar per-column ownership pattern. Q4 packed bytes are shared by adjacent columns, so a tile owner can load each packed byte once and emit both columns while preserving d/dmin/scale/min arithmetic and exact F16 bytes. This is new dataflow at the producer boundary, not a reopened projection geometry.
next_lane.first_gate: Add a separate exact Q4 pair-owned F16 producer. Require source-F16 byte exactness at nonzero tile offsets and producer-inclusive complete-chain wins at every existing production Q4 role/tile policy and M512/1K/4K on both boards. Stop or shape-scope if any required cell loses; only then promote the Q4 composite pointer.
next_lane.ceiling_note: Immediate isolated Q4 producer ceiling is 16.725 ms; no claim assumes all of it is removable.
